prd.title: PRD: Decision maps in clawpm (CLAWP-103 merge plan)
prd.body_markdown:
## Objective
clawpm gains wayfinder's decide-before-build shape as a task kind: decision tickets with recorded resolutions, a root map (destination / decisions so far / not yet specified / out of scope), a frontier query, blocking edges at emission, and a planner chart mode. No second tracker, no second spec store.

## Why
CLAWP-103 gap analysis (ADR docs/design/ADR-2026-09-02-planning-merge-plan.md). clawpm already has predictions, rubric-gated dispatch, leases, won't-do ledger and an emission API; the missing shape is the one wayfinder has: decide first, one decision per session, fog kept coarse until sharp.

## Constraints
- Extend clawpm core / clawpm-planner only (WONT-DO 2026-07-14: no parallel planning system).
- New frontmatter keys omitted when default so existing task files are byte-identical.
- Zero LLM calls in core; all judgment stays in the planner skill.
- Round-trip tests for every new field through tasks add, tasks edit, emit-tree.

## Out of scope
- OpenSpec-style spec deltas folded into .project/SPEC.md on close (fog).
- GitHub-issue distribution of maps (CLAWP-058).
- Persona system (routed to code-quorum as lens checklists).

## Success definition
A planner run in chart mode emits a decision map that `clawpm next --frontier <root>` can walk; resolving a decision with `clawpm done --resolution` updates the map's Decisions-so-far; fog graduates via `tasks add --graduates`; the plugin exposes /clawpm:plan, /clawpm:chart, /clawpm:next.

## Chosen approach
See ADR sections D1-D6. Leaves are vertical slices per user-visible guarantee.

## Open questions
- Whether `resolution` should also be mirrored into a research entry of type decision for cross-project recall (deferred; the task file is the record).

## Traceability
Ground: clawpm source at fork/main 06a32b7 read directly (models.py, emit_tree.py, cli/shortcuts.py next, tasks.py get_next_task, leases). No graph consulted; effort estimates are read-based, tagged UNGROUNDED-GRAPH.

leaves.title: A task can be a decision: kind:decision, done requires --resolution, parent map gains a Decisions-so-far line

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN a task file has kind: decision THEN Task.kind loads as decision and a task without the key loads as build with no frontmatter diff on save
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: tests: load/save round-trip for both kinds; existing fixture files unchanged byte-for-byte

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN clawpm done <id> runs on a kind:decision task without --resolution THEN it errors decision_needs_resolution and the task stays open
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: CLI test asserting error code and unchanged state

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN done --resolution runs on a decision leaf with a parent THEN frontmatter resolution/resolved_at are set and the parent body gains one line under ## Decisions so far formatted - [<title>](<id>): <first line>
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: test reads parent file after done and asserts the section and line

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN a decision task closes THEN its task_done reflection event carries kind: decision
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: test reads the JSONL event

stop_conditions: If adding kind requires changing the directory-encoded state model, STOP and report; kind is a frontmatter attribute, not a state.
If tasks edit cannot preserve the new fields without fixing CLAWP-108 first, STOP and report the dependency rather than fencing it locally.

predictions.approach: Add kind Literal + resolution/resolved_at to Task; extend parsing/serialisation with omit-when-default; guard in the done transition (services layer, not CLI-only); append to parent body via the existing frontmatter/body writer; tag reflection event. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: The done path is shared by shortcuts.done and tasks state; guarding only one leaves a bypass.

leaves.title: A root task is a map: destination + not_yet_specified sections, fog graduates via tasks add --graduates

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN a task has destination or not_yet_specified in frontmatter THEN tasks show renders ## Destination, ## Decisions so far, ## Not yet specified, ## Out of scope sections in that order; absent fields render no section
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: render tests for present/absent combinations

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN tasks add --parent <root> --graduates "<text>" matches exactly one fog entry (exact or case-insensitive prefix) THEN the child is created and that entry is removed from the root; zero or multiple matches error listing candidates and create nothing
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: CLI tests for one/zero/many matches

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN tasks fog <root> --add/--drop run THEN the list changes and nothing else in the file changes
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: diff test on the task file

out_of_scope: auto-populating Decisions so far (L1 owns it)
stop_conditions: If the body renderer cannot be extended without rewriting existing task bodies, STOP and propose storing sections only in frontmatter.

predictions.approach: Two new Task fields (omit-when-default); a small section renderer used by show; --graduates as an option on tasks add that runs after the child is persisted, in the same file lock. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: Prefix matching on free text is ambiguous; the error path listing candidates is the safety net and must be tested.

leaves.title: emit-tree can emit a decision map: leaf kind + depends_refs, root destination + not_yet_specified, validated example

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN a leaf carries kind: decision and depends_refs: [refs] THEN the minted tasks have kind set and depends resolved to the minted ids of those refs, atomically with the rest of the tree
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: emit test asserting depends on the persisted files

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN depends_refs names an unknown ref or forms a cycle THEN --dry-run and the real emit both fail validation with no writes
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: tests for unknown ref and 2-node cycle

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN depends_refs contains id:<existing-task-id> under attach_to THEN the dependency resolves to that id
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: attach_to test

success_criteria.criterion: skills/clawpm-planner/examples/decision-map.emit.json exists and passes clawpm tasks emit-tree --dry-run; references/emission-contract.md documents the four new keys
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: CI example-validation test includes the new example

out_of_scope: Task model fields (L1/L2 must land first)
stop_conditions: If L1 or L2 have not merged, STOP; this leaf depends on Task.kind, destination and not_yet_specified existing.

predictions.approach: Extend ALLOWED_LEAF_KEYS/ALLOWED_TOP_KEYS; resolve refs after ids are minted, before promote; topological check in validate. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: Ref resolution happens after id minting but promote is all-or-nothing; a resolution failure after staging must roll back the staged dir.

leaves.title: An agent can see the frontier: clawpm next --frontier <root> and tasks list --frontier <root>

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN next --frontier <root> runs THEN JSON has frontier (open children at any depth whose depends are all done and that hold no active lease), blocked [{id, waiting_on}], claimed [{id, lease_holder}], ordered by priority then id
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: fixture tree with one of each case; assert membership and order

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN text format is used THEN every task is printed as its title with the id in brackets after it, never a bare id
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: text output test

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN the root has no open children THEN the command reports the map is clear with exit 0
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: empty case test

stop_conditions: If lease lookup requires a per-task file read that makes the query O(n^2) on large trees, STOP and report before optimising.

predictions.approach: Reuse list_tasks parent/child linking + depends satisfaction from get_next_task + active-lease set from leases.py; one pure function frontier(config, project, root) shared by both commands. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: Lease staleness: an expired lease must not count as claimed; use the existing lease-expiry rule, don't reinvent it.

leaves.title: clawpm-planner can chart: chart mode, interview discipline, explorer/architect fan-out, WHEN/THEN criteria, default stop-list

success_criteria.criterion: SKILL.md documents chart mode with its trigger (>=2 open decisions block decompose, or operator asks), its output (decision map via emit-tree with kind:decision leaves, depends_refs, destination, fog), its stop rule, and the no-fog exit
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: section present; a reviewer can execute chart mode from the text alone against examples/decision-map.emit.json

success_criteria.criterion: stage-playbook.md recon names feature-dev:code-explorer as the fan-out agent when installed with the return-key-files-then-read rule; specify carries the interview discipline (one question at a time, facts looked up not asked, false-yes rejected); l/xl ideate compares minimal/clean/pragmatic lenses and recommends one
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: three sections present and cross-linked from SKILL.md

success_criteria.criterion: decompose-vet.md recommends WHEN/THEN criterion phrasing and defines the default stop-list (auth/session, schema migration, bulk deletion, secrets, payment, prod config) seeded into stop_conditions unless waived in the PRD; scale-dial.md places chart mode between m and l
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: sections present; example leaves in examples/ updated to the phrasing

success_criteria.criterion: All example documents under skills/clawpm-planner/examples pass emit-tree --dry-run after the edits
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: existing example-validation test green

out_of_scope: importing mattpocock or osmani skill files verbatim
stop_conditions: If L3 has not merged, STOP: the decision-map example cannot validate without depends_refs/kind support.

predictions.approach: Docs-only PR against the planner skill; source text is ADR D5 plus the wayfinder/osmani/feature-dev mechanics cited there. Keep SKILL.md under its current length budget by moving detail into references.
predictions.pre_mortem: Chart mode written as an option gets ignored; write it as a rule with a trigger.

leaves.title: Working a map is documented and reachable: SKILL.md rules (one decision per session, refer by name, HITL never self-answers) and plugin commands /clawpm:plan /clawpm:chart /clawpm:next

success_criteria.criterion: skills/clawpm/SKILL.md has a Working the map section: next --frontier -> start (claim) -> resolve -> done --resolution -> graduate fog; one decision leaf per session with agent research leaves exempt; names wrap ids in narration; human-delegable leaves are never answered by the agent
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: section present and consistent with L1/L2/L4 CLI surfaces

success_criteria.criterion: commands/clawpm-plan.md, clawpm-chart.md, clawpm-next.md exist, each <=15 lines of routing into the clawpm-planner skill or clawpm next, and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json lists them
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: claude plugin validate passes locally; commands appear in the plugin listing after reinstall

out_of_scope: the harness-side ~/.claude/skills/clawpm mirror (sync hook handles tracked content)
stop_conditions: If marketplace.json commands schema differs from the memory reference (claude plugin marketplace schema), STOP and check the live schema before guessing.

predictions.approach: Docs + three command files + manifest edit; verify with claude plugin validate and a local marketplace reinstall (note: plugin CLI writes live settings.json - re-diff before trusting the PR).
predictions.pre_mortem: SKILL.md mirror at ~/.claude/skills/clawpm is a checkout whose SKILL.md was untracked once; confirm the file is tracked so the sync hook carries it.
